notes: This paper outlines the findings of an IEA Wind Task 43 sub-group which investigated the degree to which the availability of industry standards and guidelines support those activities and disciplines and contribute to higher asset value. A framework for assessing the coverage of standards and guidelines is presented along with findings from a preliminary gap analysis indicating potential areas for improvement.
title: An Investigation of the Standards Landscape in the Wind Energy Sector
